featureShowcase.title: Everything you need for learning that works, without the detours.
featureShowcase.subtitle: From source knowledge to a finished, interactive course. No content team, no weeks of lead time.

detail.body: Connect your approved sources once. Scibly reads policies, handbooks, and specialist documents and automatically builds structured lessons with matching learning objectives and quiz questions. When the original document changes, scibly updates the course automatically, with no manual work from you.
highlights: Direct import from Confluence, Notion, PDF, DOCX, and PPTX
Automatically structured lessons including matching quiz questions
Courses stay current: source changes sync automatically
Runs on Scibly AI or your own model, you decide

channels.title: Learning, right in the flow of work

detail.body: Learning belongs in the workday, not just in another tool. Scibly delivers short lessons and quizzes right where your team already communicates: in Slack or Microsoft Teams. No one has to log in separately or open a new portal. The knowledge shows up exactly where and when it’s needed.
highlights: Delivered directly in Slack and Microsoft Teams
Short micro lessons of a few minutes, right in the thread
No extra portal for everyday practice

channels.chat1Text: Anyone have the Q3 deck handy?
channels.chat2Text: In the shared drive, I’ll send the link in a sec.
channels.quizQ: How long does your password need to be per the security policy?

learner.title: Motivating learning through playful elements

detail.body: Nobody finishes long slide decks voluntarily. Scibly replaces them with short challenges your team actually wants to complete. Multiple choice, cloze, drag and drop, matching tasks, and more. The same question blocks you edit in the builder reach the learner directly, including points, progress, and recognition.
highlights: Progress, points, and levels keep people going

learner.question: A Slack DM asks for your password to fix SSO. What do you do?
learner.optA: Refuse and report it to IT
learner.optB: Send the password so work can continue
learner.optC: Change it, then send the new one
learner.clozeBefore: If someone emails for your password, you should

analytics.title: See where knowledge is missing.

detail.body: Ask Scibly AI questions in plain everyday language instead of piecing reports together yourself. You instantly see where fail rates are rising, what changed, and where training is needed next. No spreadsheet export, no manual analysis.
highlights: Ask questions in plain everyday language
Spot trends and knowledge gaps at a glance
Clear link between events and learning needs, with no extra work

analytics.query: Is there a knowledge gap in sales?
analytics.gapBody: Yes. Since the new commission model, the fail rate has risen noticeably. The team still isn’t solid on this topic.

byoai.title: Use the AI your company already trusts.

detail.body: No vendor lock in. Use the models your security team has already approved instead of locking yourself into a single provider. Switch anytime between OpenAI, Anthropic, Scibly AI, or your own internal endpoint, without rebuilding the platform.
highlights: OpenAI, Anthropic, and Scibly AI built in
Full company control, without locking into one provider
Your own internal model can be connected too

byoai.query: Draft a 2 minute quiz on password phishing.
byoai.reply: 3 questions ready, based on your IT policy, not a public model.
